name: tron-usdt-system
description: Full-stack TRON/BSC USDT system - Backend, Landing, Scanner, Admin

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:landing && npm run install:scanner && npm run install:admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,landing,scanner,admin -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:landing" "npm run dev:scanner" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:landing && npm run build:scanner && npm run build:admin
